text:
sam: Quick heads-up 1: drafting the partner pilot acceptance criteria and feedback routing. Core asks: cohort = 8-12 partners; onboarding completion >=75% in 14 days; zero P0 regressions for first 7 days; structured feedback flows into Product/ML/Eng. open to tweaks.
olivia: I like the numbers. A couple of operational constraints: limit concurrent "heavy" partners to 3 until we validate Dedicated autoscaling. Also require a short canonical prompt pack per partner before acceptance.
diego: Can own the prompt pack. Proposal: require 12 prompts covering short+long context, tool calls, structured outputs, and 2 embedding queries. Those should run during onboarding and weekly via a harness.
rachel: Legal/KMS note: add explicit checkbox in intake for PII or regulated data. If they require private VPC/HSM, mark as private-preview and send to Ops for provisioning.
tony: Success metrics suggestion: week-2 NPS >=6/10 for the cohort, median daily token usage > 600 for at least 50% of partners, and at least one actionable item per partner logged into the feedback pipeline. Also do 30-min "value interview" with top 4 partners.
pilot-bot: Intake template: https://internal.redwood/apply/pilot-template 1 - please use "partner intake" and include tags: region, workload-type, private-request.
olivia: For feedback routing: can we automate triage? simple rules: keyword/label match -> ML ("accuracy/regression"), runtime ("latency/crash"), product ("UX/confusing"). send a weekly digest thread to #product-pilot-feedback.
diego: I'll build the minimal daily eval harness to run the prompt pack and push metrics (latency, success rate, embedding drift score) to the partner workspace. Need eng-runtime help for trace hooks and kv cache metrics.
rachel: On incentives: recommend $1k in credits + 3 months of priority support for high-signal partners. Legal requires a DPA before credit activation. I'll auto-block credits until DPA signed.
sam: Launch gating thought: soft private preview if >=3 partners finish onboarding with no P0 for 7 days; broader private preview after 10 partners with NPS + eval pass. Too cautious?
tony: sounds cautious but safe. Add rollback: repeatable P1 within 72 hours -> canary rollback + incident review.
olivia: Pre-acceptance checklist: intake form filled, prompt pack submitted, infra whitelist done, monitoring hooks (trace, kv cache hit), and trial SLA signed.
diego: I'll add the prompt template to the intake form and the eval harness README in the repo. PR by EOD Thursday.
sam: Who will run partner-facing weekly syncs? I can do kickoff intros.
tony: I'll run weekly syncs and own the scorecard + the first two value interviews.
rachel: I'll track legal/KMS/VPC gating and flag partners needing private deployment.
olivia: I'll configure triage automation and the weekly digest in #product-pilot-feedback.
pilot-bot: Reminder: intake form must be completed before scheduling kickoff.
sam: I'll update the pilot plan doc with these acceptance gates and post the recruitment message today. :thumbsup:
